name: Sunny Strength® Premium Adjustable Dumbbell 55 LBS (Single)

values.features:
• SECOND WEIGHT ADJUSTMENTS: Easily change weight from 15, 25, 35, 45, 55 LB by simply twisting the handle. Rapidly increase or decrease weight between exercises or as you gain strength.
• SPACE-SAVING DESIGN: Replaces an entire dumbbell set with one compact adjustable dumbbell to maximize workout area. Small footprints take up minimal room in your home gym.
• SECURE PLATE LOCKING: Plates lock firmly into place at each weight setting to prevent shifting or wobbling during exercises. The dial system ensures weights are securely fastened for each rep.
• DURABLE CONSTRUCTION: Plates and handle made of solid carbon steel and coated in powder coating for extra protection and corrosion resistance. Provides a sturdy feel during any exercise routine.
• SECURE DUMBBELL HOLDER: Dumbbell rests on wide, flat polypropylene base that provides stability when not in use. Only adjust weight settings when dumbbell is safely housed in base tray. Do not attempt to change weight while holding dumbbell.
• FREE TRAINING RESOURCES: Access SunnyFit App weight training courses and videos for guidance on proper form and technique. Low-impact exercises protect joints while sculpting and toning.
• FULL BODY TRAINING: Adjustable weight allows you to work on different muscle groups for a complete workout. Build strength in arms, shoulders, back, core, and legs with a single dumbbell.
• TRUSTED BRAND: Sunny Health & Fitness, a leading fitness brand for 20+ years, offers quality products backed by dedicated customer service and expert guidance.

• CAST IRON: Made from high-grade cast iron for durability and high-performance strength training.
